name: 442-press-playout
reply:
What I saw
- You requested an 11v11 setup showing our ATT 4-3-3 building out against a DEF 4-4-2 high press.

On the board
- Set pitch intent to our defensive third to highlight the initial play-out phase under pressure.
- Placed ATT #1 (GK) and split CBs (#4, #5) wide to stretch the opponent's front two.
- Dropped ATT #6 between the central defenders to create a numerical advantage against the press.
- Added pass and movement arrows showing the single pivot receiving to connect play.

Coaching points
- Ball security comes first: circulate quickly to move the opponent's first line of pressure.
- Scan early before receiving so you know your escape lane on the half-turn.
- Provide clear support angles by keeping distances short and avoiding crowded vertical lines.
